record.question: Highest population growth rate (2011 census) in India was recorded in the state of
record.explanation: Answer A: Meghalaya. Meghalaya recorded 27.95% decadal population growth in Census 2011, the highest among Indian states and among these options. Assam's official census-based comparison gives Assam 17.07%, Tripura 14.84% and Meghalaya 27.95%; Mizoram is 23.48%. Union territories are a different comparison group. Historical/source note: Decadal 2001–2011 growth among states, not annual growth and not a ranking including union territories. Reference: https://transdev.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/pndd_medhassu_in_oid_2/portlet/level_2/final.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
